fit_origin_rule: fit(origin) admits targets <origin; origin2026 is final freeze through2025, not evaluation of2026
history: Baseline four completed years; latest annual state plus prior-season last60 team-game state and low/established exposure history. No age, chart, injury, external forecast, minor or Statcast covariate in this first arm.
hitter_label: Positive PA versus zero PA. MLB G and batting G remain separate joint workload outputs; a zero-PA state is not called MLB nonappearance.
pitcher_label: Credited pitching G>0, including zero-out/no-pitch games; zero pitching G only certified.
secondary_role: Hitter arm baseline fallback if prior latest season has >=5 credited pitching G and <100 PA; all cases remain in baseline comparison cohort and fallback reporting. This is a predictor-time rule, not target-role filtering.
exception_policy: Danny Jansen2024 hitter player-season quarantined for target use and as any required latest feature. Ryan Jeffers/Sean Keys2026 stay outside this build; later2027 feature builder must enforce quarantine. No source count correction or relaxed reconciliation.
missing_policy: Unknown labels cannot become zeros. Latest feature UNKNOWN => full baseline fallback. Last60 unknown may back off via fixed pool hierarchy.
calendar: Training workload vectors divided by observed source-season maximum team games (label normalization, including2020). At prediction multiply joint workload expectation by explicit planned calendar, default162 for a normal season. Target realized calendar is never a predictor. This normalization is an unvalidated hypothesis, not a post-score adjustment.
estimator: Empirical four-state transition distribution. Root Laplace1 per state; latest-state and latest/recent/experience pools shrink by50 pseudo-rows to parent. Pool probabilities need >=200 known rows and20 positive/20 zero. State workload means need >=20 rows, otherwise parent means. Shrink conditional vectors by50 parent rows, preserving joint quantity products rather than multiplying marginal means.
global_support: >=200 known labels; >=20 positive and20 zero; >=20 each active state. Pitcher support also >=50 pure-start and100 pure-relief target seasons, retaining legacy support floors. Whole role falls back on unsupported root.
fallback: Return FULL_BASELINE_FALLBACK with workload=None for unsupported features, secondary pitching batting or global support; no partly replaced vector, zero fill or hidden floor. Sparse pools back off deterministically; support is exposed.
output: Experimental workload-only: hitter MLB_G/BATTING_G/STARTS/PA; pitcher G/GS/GR/START_OUTS/RELIEF_OUTS/OUTS/IP. State probabilities experimental, not calibrated medical/availability probabilities. No forecast file is generated by this registration.
coherence: Original skill rates and all production vectors remain untouched. Full fantasy counts and team opportunity budgets are not implemented; no adoption is possible until separately specified complete-count recomputation and team checks exist.
additional_guard_policy: Retain applicable previous pitcher workload G/GS, role/freshness and complete-count protections. No weaker minimum fold/sample/improvement/cohort rules; no automatic promotion.
forbidden: real-data fitting or scoring during this build
next_step: Review registration then execute fixed earlier-only test in a separate scored build; do not tune using those errors
pitcher_zero_extension: Candidate-only certificate for four-year prior-positive-OUTS IDs absent from complete reconstructed pitching season, with no positive eligible G/OUTS contradiction. Original overlays and labels unchanged. Unknown remains unknown if evidence checks fail.
